title: Tavern 0.6.205: reset effect snapshot recipient sessions
public_notes_inline: Effect snapshot delivery resets per-player cache on leave and initial spawn, so a same-ID reconnect between publishes receives its initial empty authority snapshot. Same-session idle deduplication and active-row heartbeat/TTL semantics remain unchanged. Source validation uses the actual publisher/SDK with Native API boundary fixtures; native rapid reconnect is not claimed. Saved data and API modules are unchanged.
